title: The Italian Job
curatorNote: Eletrizante refilmagem de F. Gary Gray com Mark Wahlberg, Charlize Theron, Edward Norton e Jason Statham. Uma equipe de ladrões planeja roubar um cofre de ouro em Los Angeles com Mini Coopers.
curatorReason: Planejamento milimétrico, perseguições urbanas cheias de estilo e a dinâmica perfeita de uma equipe de especialistas improváveis.

omdb.title: The Italian Job
omdb.writer: Troy Kennedy Martin, Donna Powers, Wayne Powers
omdb.actors: Donald Sutherland, Mark Wahlberg, Edward Norton
omdb.plot: Led by John Bridger (Donald Sutherland) and Charlie Croker (Mark Wahlberg) a team is assembled for one last heist to steal $35 million in gold bars from a heavily guarded safe in Venice, Italy. After successfully pulling off the heist, a team member, Steve (Edward Norton), driven by greed and jealousy, arranges to take the gold for himself and eliminate the remaining members of the group. Thinking the team dead, he returns to Los Angeles with the gold. Charlie and the survivors of this betrayal follow Steve to L.A. to exact revenge against the traitor. Charlie enlists the help of John Bridger's daughter, Stella (Charlize Theron) - a professional safe cracker - to get revenge. With Stella and the hacking skills of Lyle (Seth Green), the explosives skills of "Left Ear" (Yasiin Bey), and the driving skills of "Handsome" Rob (Jason Statham) this new team plans and executes a daring heist that weaves through the freeways and subways of L.A.

title: The Town
curatorNote: Thriller criminal elogiado dirigido e estrelado por Ben Affleck com Jeremy Renner e Rebecca Hall. Um grupo de assaltantes de bancos de Charlestown entra na mira implacável do FBI.
curatorReason: Cenas de tiroteio realistas e pulsantes, lealdade de sangue nas ruas e o conflito existencial entre a vida no crime e a redenção pessoal.

omdb.title: The Town
omdb.writer: Peter Craig, Ben Affleck, Aaron Stockard
omdb.actors: Ben Affleck, Rebecca Hall, Jon Hamm
omdb.plot: The Charlestown neighborhood of Boston is renowned for churning out a high number of armed robbers, generation after generation. These robbers never leave their Charlestown life of their own volition, the neighborhood where there is an unwritten code to protect that lifestyle. Such robbers include friends Doug MacRay, James Coughlin, Albert 'Gloansy' Magloan, and Desmond Elden. Doug and James in particular treat each other like family, as the Coughlins have realistically been to Doug since his mother ran off and his father, Stephen MacRay, was sent to prison. Doug has a casual-sex relationship with Krista Coughlin, James' drugged-out single-mother sister. The foursome carry out a mostly-successful bank robbery, but circumstances make them take the bank manager, Claire Keesey, hostage for a short time before releasing her physically unharmed. They find out that Claire lives in Charlestown, so they want to ensure that she saw nothing that could incriminate them if they would ever run into her, so Doug begins a personal relationship with her to find out what she knows and what she's told the police and the FBI, who have taken charge of the investigation. He learns that she has kept some information from the authorities for her own protection--that could specifically identify James. But Doug slowly falls for her, as she does for him. Ultimately, Doug dreams about leaving his Charlestown life to be with Claire--anywhere but there. He must try to keep his true identity from her, and keep the fact that he's seeing her from his colleagues. But leaving is not easy; he and the gang are tasked with a big job by a local gangster named Fergie whether Doug likes it or not. And Adam Frawley, the FBI's lead investigator, comes into evidence that links the foursome to the bank robbery and a subsequent armored car heist, so is on their tail for evidence that will send them away dead or alive.

title: Hell or High Water
curatorNote: Indicado a 4 Oscars incluindo Melhor Filme, com roteiro brilhante de Taylor Sheridan e estrelado por Chris Pine e Jeff Bridges. Dois irmãos assaltam filiais do banco que quer confiscar a fazenda da família.
curatorReason: Um faroeste moderno melancólico sobre justiça econômica, desespero do Texas profundo e o laço inquebrável de irmandade.

omdb.title: Hell or High Water
omdb.actors: Chris Pine, Ben Foster, Jeff Bridges
omdb.plot: In West Texas, two brothers go on a bank-robbing rampage. They are targeting the branches of one bank in particular, The Texas Midland Bank. This bank is about to foreclose on the mortgage on their ranch and claim the property, and robbing the bank to pay its own loan seems appropriate. On the trail of the brothers is a Texas Ranger, Marcus Hamilton, with only a few weeks to retirement.
